newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Cheiljedang buys 35,000T U.S. soybean.
newsitem.headline: Cheiljedang buys 35,000T U.S. soybean.

text.p: South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp bought 35,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 soybean at basis over January futures on the Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT), a company official said on Monday.
The official said the company bought the soybean from Mitsubishi Corp for shipment in early December from the U.S. Gulf.
Arrival was set for the western port city of Inchon.

"We fixed the basis with the supplier for our long positions on the CBOT. Our supplier will take care of our long positions by using the Exchange Futures for Physical (EFP)," the official said, declining to give further details.
